items.title: 3 Dividend Aristocrats With the Most Room to Keep Raising Their Dividends
items.summary: Some S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats raise their payouts every year mostly out of habit, but a few have payout ratios so low that a rough recession barely threatens the next increase. Three names on the roster stand out for the sheer amount of room they have left to run.
